scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend && npm run build -w extension
scripts.lint: npm run build -w shared && npm run lint --workspaces --if-present && tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json
scripts.test: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w @gobuy/tensor-adapter && node --import tsx --test tensor-adapter/tests/*.test.mjs shared/tests/*.test.ts backend/tests/*.test.ts frontend/tests/*.test.ts extension/tests/*.test.ts
scripts.build:extension: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w extension
